title: Promo Code
description: Voucher card with a code field and apply button, removable chips for applied promo codes and gift cards, a confirmation notice, and the order total after deductions.

components.PromoCode: Lets the shopper apply promo codes and shows the discounts they take off the order.
components.PromoCodeField: The promo code field with its hint, the applied codes as removable chips and an optional notice; PromoCode's body, for placing inside another summary.
